title: Thai-Style Steamed Turkey with Malt Pudding Sauce
description: A twist on traditional steamed turkey, this Thai-inspired dish features a flavorful malt pudding sauce and a hint of British spices.

ingredients.name: Steamed
ingredients.notes: steaming liquid, such as water or chicken broth

instructions: Rinse the turkey neck and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small saucepan, combine the malty, light, and British. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Add the steamed to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Place the turkey neck in a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the pudding according to package instructions.
To serve, slice the cooked turkey neck and serve with the malt pudding sauce spooned over the top.
